issues.sentence: Six acts, one racetrack, and a border crossing I made for Oingo Boingo.
issues.evidence: The fact sheet only confirms residence in Orange County around 1992; it does not confirm any border crossing or travel act.

issues.sentence: The show was at Caliente Racetrack in Tijuana — I crossed the border for it.
issues.evidence: No owner-confirmed personal fact supports a border crossing claim.

issues.sentence: I drove to Tijuana for a concert in 1987.
issues.evidence: No owner-confirmed personal fact supports driving or mode of travel to the show.

issues.sentence: Oingo Boingo headlined, four months after BOI-NGO came out.
issues.evidence: BOI-NGO released 1987-03-02; show was 1987-06-30, which is just under four months (about 3 months, 28 days), not a clean four months.
issues.replacement: Oingo Boingo headlined, about four months after BOI-NGO came out.

issues.sentence: Hoodoo Gurus had been a band for five years.
issues.evidence: The fact sheet gives no formation year for Hoodoo Gurus, so any stated band age is invented.
The fact sheet lists no career-stage information for Chris Isaak; his debut album 'Silvertone' (1985) predates this 1987 show by two years, so 'just starting' is unconfirmed.

issues.sentence: Thirty-six years ago today, this was my first of eight times seeing Social Distortion — but I didn't see them again until 2005.
issues.evidence: The show was on 1990-09-13, and today is 2026-09-14 per the fact sheet — the 36-year anniversary was yesterday, not today.
issues.replacement: Thirty-six years ago yesterday, this was my first of eight times seeing Social Distortion — but I didn't see them again until 2005.
